subject: psychology
title: Brain & Nervous System: Foundations
welcome_lead: Map the central and peripheral nervous systems.
meta_desc: GCSE Psychology adventure on the nervous system: CNS, PNS and autonomic divisions.
final_note: You can sketch the nervous system from CNS down to autonomic.

concepts.def: Central nervous system: brain and spinal cord.
Automatic control of organs and glands.

walkthroughs.body_html: The nervous system splits into CNS (brain + spinal cord) and PNS (all other nerves). The PNS then splits into somatic (voluntary) and autonomic (automatic).

Sympathetic: raises heart rate, dilates pupils, slows digestion — prepares the body for action (fight-or-flight). Parasympathetic: slows heart, narrows pupils, restarts digestion — returns to calm (rest-and-digest).

The spinal cord is a highway for nerve signals between body and brain. It also coordinates simple reflex arcs without needing the brain — that's why your hand pulls back from a flame before you feel pain.
